explain_publish: Share news, events, announcements and janaza notices on the mosque's page.
explain_details: Update the address, contact details and description so people find you easily.
explain_community: Read the comments left on your posts and hide those that are not appropriate.
explain_verify: Collecting donations, zakat or charity is not available yet. When it is, it will be open only to mosques whose documents and finances our team has verified.
step_1: Send your request with your role at the mosque and, if you can, a supporting document.
step_2: Our team reviews it and may contact you to confirm.
step_3: You receive an email with the decision. Once approved, the page is yours to manage.
form_intro: Tell us who you are at the mosque. Everything you send stays between you and our team.
field_role_placeholder: e.g. Imam, president of the association, secretary
field_phone_hint: Only our team sees it, to confirm your request if needed.
field_message_placeholder: Tell us how you are connected to the mosque and what you would like to publish.
document_types: PDF, JPG or PNG — up to {size} MB
document_hint: For example the association's statutes or a letter from the board. It is stored privately: only our team can open it.
privacy_note: Your request is visible only to you and the Salat Time team.
submitted: Your request has been sent. We will email you once it has been reviewed.
error_already_pending: You already have a request waiting for this mosque.
error_already_manager: You already manage this mosque's page.
state_manager_text: You can publish news and update the mosque's details from your management space.
state_pending_text: You sent it on {date}. We will email you as soon as a decision is made.
mine_intro: Your requests to manage a mosque's page and their progress.
mine_empty_text: Find your mosque on the map, open its page and choose "Manage this mosque" to send a request.
pending_hint: Our team is reviewing your request. You will receive an email with the decision.
v_role_required: Please tell us your role at the mosque.
v_role_max: Your role must be 120 characters or fewer.
v_role_invalid: Please write your role on a single line, without special characters.
v_phone: Please enter a valid phone number.
v_message_max: Your message must be 2,000 characters or fewer.

v_document_size: The document must be 8 MB or smaller.
mail_submitted_line: {claimant} has asked to manage the page of {mosque}.
mail_approved_line: Your request to manage the page of {mosque} has been approved. You can now publish news and keep the mosque's details up to date.
mail_approved_next: Donations, zakat and charity collection will come later, only for mosques whose documents and finances have been verified.
mail_rejected_line: After review, we could not approve your request to manage the page of {mosque}.
mail_rejected_next: You are welcome to send a new request with more details or a supporting document.
